attributes.board_name: Maryland Board of Examiners of Psychologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses by authorized sponsors: APA, Association for Psychological Science, AMA, NASW, NASP, Maryland Department of Health, NIH, accredited academic institutions; scholarly activities (publications, presentations, posters); peer consultation group (max 4 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial license less than 12 months before the end of the reporting period: no CE for that period; 12 months or more: 20 CE hours.

topics.who: Psychologists who supervised psychology associates during the reporting period

rules.notes: Max 20 h independent study (exam + certificate required). 3 h in laws, ethics/professional conduct or risk management. Reporting period ends March 31 of odd years (license numbers ending in odd digit) or even years (even digit or 0). Scholarly activities max 30 h.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; audited licensees renew by March 1 and must send proof plus a CE reporting form within 10 days of notice.
rules.rule_quote: A psychologist shall complete a minimum of 40 CE hours during each reporting period with a: (1) Maximum of 20 CE hours in independent study;

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses by authorized sponsors: APA, Association for Psychological Science, AMA, NASW, NASP, Maryland Department of Health, NIH, accredited academic institutions; scholarly activities (publications, presentations, posters); peer consultation group (max 4 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial registration less than 12 months before the end of the reporting period: no CE; 12 months or more: 10 CE hours.
rules.notes: Max 10 h independent study. Same March 31 reporting periods by last digit of registration number. Scholarly activities max 15 h.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; audited licensees renew by March 1 and must send proof plus a CE reporting form within 10 days of notice.
rules.rule_quote: A psychology associate shall complete a minimum of 20 CE hours during each reporting period with a: (1) Maximum of 10 CE hours in independent study;
